execution.ref: Graphite stage A and L1-L4 rounds, 2026-10-10
execution.description: The stage A Constructor grant and the L1-L4 round launched under it, and two executor slips found in them.

expected: A grant's approved run count holds across every controller root, and a finished session's outputs and logs stay as written.
observed: Two executor slips. The run count of a grant is enforced per controller root, so the stage A Constructor grant (5 runs) was spent at L0 (D x3, E x2, in separate roots) and an L1 run (the 6th) then ran under it in a new root. Re-invoking the launch script for a finished session re-ran phase3 run --session 1, which printed the finished report again (no spend, no new run row) but overwrote the round-1 streaming output files and the chain logs.
keep: The launcher guard that refuses a session whose output exists, exits 3 and logs the refusal.
Outputs and logs append-only per level, lane and session.
change: The executor keeps a per-grant run ledger across roots and checks it before every launch; the preflight reads it.
A grant-level run counter that the controller consults, so no second root can exceed the approved total (Test Engineer).
Consider the same finished-session guard in phase3 run: a finished session is not re-run, or does not rewrite its report (Test Engineer).
